text.tspan: 差分数据/485通讯双向转换模块
SHDN has internal pull-up. Power-cycle to reset latched overload. One powered corner normally; no current-sharing claim. Prototype validation required.
PROGRAM: PDO1=5V/0.5A; PDO2=20V/3A; PDO count=2; POWER_ONLY_ABOVE_5V=1; POWER_OK_CFG=2; REQ_SRC_CURRENT=0.
Pin order: 1 -> 5. USB must power U101.
24 modules x 1W; design target 24V / 1.5A. Use a 20V/3A PD source and 3A USB-C cable.
I2C address 0x28; J101 uses EXTERNAL 3.3V pull-ups.
